title: What Survives the Shift from Text to Pixels? Conditional Protection against Prompt Injection in Image-Rendered Documents
abstract: arXiv:2611.24231v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal language models increasingly answer questions over external documents, exposing them to indirect prompt injection: commands planted in untrusted content to hijack the response. Rendering untrusted content as page images lowers attack success on average, leaving open which injected operations survive rendering, at what utility cost, and whether failed image attacks reflect unread commands or commands read but not followed. We pair text and page-image versions of 191 English question-answering sources across six models, measuring marker appending, answer formatting, and answer replacement alongside clean Question-Answering utility. Rendering reduces append and format execution for every model, yet Qwen3-VL-8B still executes image-borne replacement at 77.96\%. Protection also depends on target type, rendering settings, wording, and repetition, and a search over eight fixed attack candidates largely closes the image deficit in a

translated_title: 从文本到像素的转变中什么得以幸存？图像渲染文档中针对提示注入的条件性防护
translated_abstract: 多模态语言模型越来越多地基于外部文档回答问题，这使其暴露于间接提示注入攻击：即植入在不可信内容中、旨在劫持模型响应的命令。将不可信内容渲染为页面图像平均上可降低攻击成功率，但仍存在未解问题：哪些注入操作能在渲染后幸存、会带来何种效用代价、以及图像攻击失败究竟是因为命令未被读取，还是命令被读取却未被遵循。我们在六个模型上对191个英文问答来源配对文本版和页面图像版，测量标记追加、答案格式化和答案替换三类攻击行为，同时评估干净问答的效用。渲染降低了所有模型的追加与格式化攻击执行率，但Qwen3-VL-8B仍能以77.96%的比率执行图像承载的答案替换攻击。防护效果还依赖于目标类型、渲染设置、措辞和重复次数，并且对八个固定攻击候选的搜索在很大程度上缩小了图像版本与文本版本之间的防御差距。
tldr: 该论文系统评估了将不可信文档渲染为图像对间接提示注入的防护效果，发现渲染虽普遍降低攻击成功率，但部分攻击（如答案替换）仍可高达约78%，且防护效果取决于攻击目标类型、渲染设置、措辞与重复等条件因素。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates image-rendering as a defense against indirect prompt injection, showing that while rendering reduces most attacks on average, certain operations like answer replacement still succeed at up to 77.96%, and protection is conditional on target type, rendering settings, wording, and repetition.
